title: CSCTech
description: Official modpack for the private CSC server.
body:
# CSCTech

A light-weight modpack focusing around Create, Industrial Foregoing and the Thermal series with amazing performance and some extra funny mods meant to introduce the people of Circle Strafe Community to their first tech mods using custom comprehensive questlines. Can also be played independently from the server, if you want to start dipping your toes in tech mods using a well-built pack designed for smooth progression and multiplayer play.

Can optionally be played with Distant Horizons, Physics Mod, and Sound Physics Remastered
